structure Poised (n:ℕ)(z:ℝ)(k:ℕ)(t:ℕ→ℕ→TableL C D):Prop where
    early : ∀ d,d ≤ D → C.ref d ≤ k
    limit : wheel A k ≤ (A).clock.monitor k
    charts : ∀ N p, k < N→ Charting D k (t N p) N p
    supply (χ:ι) : ∃ l r,∃ h:LegacyCost B J (-3) z ((P χ).bag ((A).clock.J k)) k n D O l r,∀ N p (hx:k<N),∃ V,Actum B H O J (P χ) h V hx ∧ ∀ d:Fin (D+1),∃ L:StampDuty C k N p d ((P χ).bag ((A).clock.J k)).taylor V ((P χ).bag ((A).clock.J k)).era.coast.Q (stamp A N p),L.T=t N p d

proof_context.conclusion: The window hypotheses (entry level, error bounds, source recurrence) are the fields of `Poised` (`early`, `limit`, `charts`, `supply`).

snippet.text:
structure Allowed (k : ℕ) : Prop where
  positive : 0<k
  reserves : height A b k + surplus A k ≤ k
  plateau (m : ℕ) : width A b k ≤ m → m≤k → A.clock.J m=A.clock.J k

proof_context.conclusion: `Allowed A b k`: positivity, reserved margin, and constant stage (`plateau`) on the window, so a window need not stay in one stage only through `J m = J k`.
